_about: Fast-travel network (List 13 #125). The network is a DERIVED SET over #11's route graph — no unlock list is ever stored (#12's derived-never-stored law applied to travel, the same refusal #98 made for Fragments). A node is travel-eligible iff it is annotated a travel point AND the arrival evidence #32's map-reveal derivation reads for that node shows the Ranger has reached it. Because eligibility requires prior arrival through the graph's real gates, sequence-breaking into an unvisited area is unrepresentable by construction. The node annotation is a PROPOSED additive field: the graph's workspace copy (world-systems/region1-route-graph.json) is verified, its in-repo schema is an UNVERIFIED TARGET for landing. Zero nodes are annotated by this package.

derivation.eligible: travelPoint(node) == true AND arrived(node) per #32 reveal evidence
derivation.inputs: #11 route graph (nodes/edges/gates) + #12 flag state as read by #32
derivation.stored: nothing — recomputed whenever the set is shown (#96: the system has no save section)

node_annotation_proposed.field: travelPoint: boolean (additive on the #11 node record)
node_annotation_proposed.status: PROPOSED — landing verifies against the graph's real repo schema before any annotation lands
node_annotation_proposed.which_nodes: OPEN — an annotation pass over the real Region 1 graph; zero annotated here

travel_behaviour.clock: OPEN — instant vs phase-advancing (#19) is an owner ruling; neither taken
travel_behaviour.cost: OPEN — no fee asserted; a #20 currency fee is possible and unruled
travel_behaviour.edges: not traversed, gates not re-tested — safe by construction (see _about)
travel_behaviour.show_lane: none — game-lane compression only; show journeys play at full length
